_note: Tier 2, oldest end. 1-6 October 2025: the church diagnosis, ten cities with a hundred men, glory events.

mentions.claim_text: He reports the Lord saying what is wrong with America is the church, and that it turns if the pastors preach the uncompromising word.
mentions.quote: what is wrong with America is the church
mentions.falsify_match: Not a claim: a diagnosis with a condition and no measure on either side.

mentions.claim_text: He says the Lord told him that if they want America back it starts in the church and spreads to the home.
mentions.quote: If you want your America back, it starts in the church
mentions.falsify_match: Not a claim: a conditional about renewal.

mentions.claim_text: He says America was a technical knockout but God has given a three and a half year window, and asks the church what it will do with it.
mentions.quote: I have given you a 3 and 1/2 year window now
mentions.falsify_match: The window closing around spring 2029 with the consequences he describes.
mentions.falsify_miss: It does not. The window has been given as four years, three and a half, and out to 2030 across the corpus.

mentions.claim_text: He says to look at what is happening after the 23rd, that it is escalating and getting more and more, and that it is getting late.
mentions.quote: look at what is happening after the 23rd. It is escalating
mentions.falsify_match: A measurable acceleration of events after 23 September 2025.
mentions.falsify_miss: None. Escalation has no threshold, so any news reads as confirmation.

mentions.claim_text: He recalls saying a major revival would take place in the Vatican, points to Italy that day, and says a major shaking is coming to Italy.
mentions.quote: A major shaking is coming to Italy
mentions.falsify_match: A major earthquake or upheaval in Italy.

mentions.claim_text: Reading a report that it could devastate California, he says he had said a massive earthquake for Seattle and British Columbia and that they are trying to warn everybody.
mentions.quote: massive earthquake Seattle, British Columbia
mentions.falsify_match: A Cascadia rupture affecting Seattle, British Columbia and California.
mentions.falsify_miss: None. He is reading a published hazard report as confirmation of his own word.

mentions.claim_text: Prayer for a major revival in South Korea, that China would not infiltrate it, and over North Korea.
mentions.quote: THAT CHINA WOULD NOT INFILTRATE South Korea
mentions.falsify_match: Not a claim: a petition.

mentions.claim_text: He says this is an antichrist spirit and move bringing civil unrest that will boil over in the streets, and that it will be in New York.
mentions.quote: It will start to boil over in the streets
mentions.falsify_match: Civil unrest boiling over in New York streets.

mentions.claim_text: He says the reaction will be civil unrest worse than BLM and names Antifa.
mentions.quote: civil unrest is worse than the BLM
mentions.falsify_match: Unrest exceeding the 2020 protests, which involved an estimated 15 to 26 million participants.

mentions.claim_text: He says Italy will be shaken and all Europe will be shaken, and that a great mighty revival will take place in Europe.
mentions.quote: Italy will be shaken. All Europe will be shaken
mentions.falsify_match: Upheaval across Europe followed by a large revival.
mentions.falsify_miss: None. Shaken is left between physical and figurative.

mentions.claim_text: He says a third temple will be built soon, repeating it, that it is all getting set up, and names acceleration, great wars and Ezekiel.
mentions.quote: a third temple will be built soon
mentions.falsify_match: Construction of a third temple beginning.
mentions.falsify_miss: None begun. Soon carries no date.

mentions.claim_text: He says this is very serious for the United States, notes he does not usually record this early, and that after being up all night the Lord told him to pray with the people.
mentions.quote: I was up all night and the Lord said pray with the people
mentions.falsify_match: Not a claim: session framing with an urgency marker.

mentions.claim_text: He says that when he tells them it is very serious it means life and death for some, given the level of what he has delivered.
mentions.quote: this will be life and death for some
mentions.falsify_match: Deaths connected to what he has warned of.
mentions.falsify_miss: None. No event, place or date is attached.

mentions.claim_text: He says the devil is trying to disrupt the coming revival, that he kept hearing the words jihad and Mahdi, and that they must create instability in America.
mentions.quote: I kept hearing the word jihad. I kept hearing the word mahdi
mentions.falsify_match: Islamist violence in America tied to a Mahdi figure.
mentions.falsify_miss: None. Two words heard, without an event attached.

mentions.claim_text: He says the open-eyed vision about America and Israel lasted almost an hour with great details, and that he nearly went live immediately but interceded first.
mentions.quote: the openeyed vision lasted probably almost an hour
mentions.falsify_match: Not a claim: a description of how the material arrived.

mentions.claim_text: Prayer thanking God for fire on the nation and for revival and awakening over America from sea to shining sea.
mentions.quote: revival, awakening unto God over America again
mentions.falsify_match: Not a claim: a petition.

mentions.claim_text: He declares that they will be defeated before their face because they are believing believers, and asks whether the audience believes it.
mentions.quote: they are going to be defeated because we are believing believers
mentions.falsify_match: Not a claim: a declaration.

mentions.claim_text: Citing Psalm 92:7 about evildoers, he thanks God for protecting Minnesota and Minneapolis that day.
mentions.quote: Thank you, Lord, for protecting Minnesota today, Minneapolis
mentions.falsify_match: Not a claim: thanks given for a quiet day, which is the answered-prayer reading of a non-event.

mentions.claim_text: He gives the Branson prayer conference dates as the 15th through the 20th and says they are going to have a meeting.
mentions.quote: The prayer conference is 15th, 16th, 17th, 18th, 19th, the 20th
mentions.falsify_match: Not a claim: a published conference schedule.

mentions.claim_text: He says he was allowed to hear a named pastor from Texarkana interceding for the nations, and that the man was in the throne room with him.
mentions.quote: he was in the throne room with me
mentions.falsify_match: Unfalsifiable: a named living person placed in a throne room vision, which only he can report.

mentions.claim_text: He speaks of Korean people joining and praying from all over the world in unity, and of the power in it.
mentions.quote: his people joining up and praying from all over the world
mentions.falsify_match: Not a claim: an observation about the audience.

mentions.claim_text: He points to a magnitude 5.9 earthquake that happened just outside somewhere, shown on screen by his son.
mentions.quote: a 5.9 earthquake happened right outside
mentions.falsify_match: Not a claim: a quake read off the news after it happened.

mentions.claim_text: He contrasts First Amendment rights in America with what is coming, saying they will see an olive press on the people.
mentions.quote: you are going to see an olive press
mentions.falsify_match: Restrictions on American free speech at the scale implied.
mentions.falsify_miss: None. Olive press is not defined.

mentions.claim_text: He notes Trump allowing Ukraine to fire long range missiles and drones deep into Russia and calls it a major deal.
mentions.quote: they can touch way deep into Russia now
mentions.falsify_match: Not a forward claim: current policy read out.

mentions.claim_text: He says he saw youth filling major auditoriums and reports the Lord saying that instead of sporting events they are about to see glory events, with a major revival.
mentions.quote: Instead of being sporting events, you are about to see glory events
mentions.falsify_match: Religious meetings filling major sports arenas.
mentions.falsify_miss: None. Arena attendance is published, which makes this checkable.

mentions.claim_text: He says he told them ten major cities with a hundred men per city and that it is right there in the news.
mentions.quote: 10 major cities with a hundred men per city
mentions.falsify_match: Ten American cities each hosting about a hundred hostile operatives.
mentions.falsify_miss: None established. The two numbers, ten and a hundred, are the checkable part, and he offers a news item as confirmation.

mentions.claim_text: He prays that it spread throughout Asia and over South and North Korea, and that the dictator would be run down.
mentions.quote: that the dictator would be run down in Jesus name
mentions.falsify_match: The removal of the North Korean leader.
mentions.falsify_miss: He remains. A petition rather than a forecast.

mentions.claim_text: He prays that those who hide be brought to justice, and gives thanks for the coming holiday season as they enter the fourth quarter.
mentions.quote: No matter how hard they try to hide, they will be brought to justice
mentions.falsify_match: Not a claim: a petition.

mentions.claim_text: He calls in the rain and rebukes drought, repeating it over the weather.
mentions.quote: We call in the rain and we rebuke drought
mentions.falsify_match: Not a claim: a petition against drought.

mentions.claim_text: Speaking prophetically he says his presence will flow and it will fall throughout California, and that he sees a wave of the glory again.
mentions.quote: It will fall throughout California. My presence will flow
mentions.falsify_match: A revival wave across California.
